{{Top|leg}}
The '''tequa bush''' was a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Joralla]]. They were barely fifty [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]] tall, but the branches could extend for several [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. They produced tasty berries.
